body:
## Summary
- Adds slowapi limits of 10/minute and 200/day on every route, per user.
- The key is the verified session subject, set by `session_claims` on `request.state`; `/health/db` falls back to the remote address.
- `key_style="endpoint"` counts per route function, so `/conversations/{id}` does not get a fresh bucket per id.
- Counters are in memory: they reset on restart and are not shared across workers.

## Test plan
- [x] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest` (176 passed)
- [ ] Not run against a live server with a real Clerk token
